messages.content: 你能為我繪製兩個正弦波嗎？第一個波的頻率應為5 Hz，從0弧度開始，到10弧度結束，振幅為2，相位差為1弧度。第二個波的頻率應為10 Hz，從0弧度開始，到20弧度結束，振幅為3，相位差為2弧度。

function.name: plot_sine_wave
function.description: Plot a sine wave for a given frequency in a given range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_range.description: Start of the range in radians.

end_range.description: End of the range in radians.

frequency.description: Frequency of the sine wave in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the sine wave. Default is 1.

phase_shift.description: Phase shift of the sine wave in radians. Default is 0.

message.reasoning:
The user wants two sine waves plotted. The tool can plot one sine wave at a time. We need to call the function twice with appropriate parameters.

We should produce a single response containing calls to the function twice. According to guidelines, we can only output one function call per assistant turn. But we can chain calls? Actually guidelines say "When you want to use a tool, your response should contain a JSON object with the name of the function and arguments." That means each assistant turn can only have one function call. So we need to do multiple turns: first call plot_sine_wave for first wave, then after receiving result, call again for second wave. But we cannot embed both calls in same response. So we will respond with first function call. Then after receiving result, we will call second. So we need to handle multi-turn conversation. We'll start with calling plot_sine_wave for first wave.
